item.title: Minor injuries reported in Ramelton multi-car collision
item.description: One person has been taken to hospital following a four-car collision in Ramelton this afternoon. Gardaí say they attended the scene at around 2 pm on the R245 in Aughnagaddy. One person was taken to hospital by ambulance as a precaution, and no other injuries have been reported. The road is expected to reopen shortly.
